newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia truckmaker Kamaz shares down 11pct.
newsitem.headline: Russia truckmaker Kamaz shares down 11pct.

text.p: Shares in truck maker Kamaz had fallen 10.65 percent to $1.510 at 1400 GMT on Tuesday from a record high of $1.690 at close Monday on the Russian Trading System.
About $380,000 had traded in Kamaz, located in the Tatarstan autonomous republic in central Russia.
Kamaz shares volatility and share price has picked up recently. On March 3 Kamaz was priced at $1.40.
Traders say Kamaz, which barely moved during a year-long rally, has attracted attention as investors look beyond leading Russian shares considered close to fairly valued.
